title: I LOVE Drafting Reality Fracture!!!
event: FRA early access event (he calls it 'the early access event' and thanks Wizards for preview access; event name not shown on screen)
source: frames read from data/videos/raw/mqZsj4Vg2Es (tools/video_draft.py frames); every pick confirmed by the next frame's deck list or pool unless a note says otherwise; transcript from YouTube auto captions (tools/video_draft.py transcript), card names corrected

colour_path.quote: We can also just splash it in any white deck.
I don't necessarily want to commit to playing that color combo
I don't want to get too committed to green.
we can just splash the Qua if we really need to or splash Twisted Fates

blue white is pretty much where I was supposed to end up just because Qua wants me to be base white
blue white just splashing green is probably the best bet
I probably shouldn't be splashing black, but we will anyway.

picks.reasoning: Kwia over Chandra: a 6/6 flier with ward 2 wins the game if unanswered; Chandra needs protection, draws a card about half the time and is easy to pressure. Wants to try the lifegain deck. Already notes Kwia can be splashed in any white deck.

considered.Chandra, Chill of Compliance: close second; needs protection, easy to pressure
considered.Koth of the Homestead: 'pretty nice'; better than Koth, the Geomancer because the counter mode matters more than the mana mode
considered.Koth, the Geomancer: does things in RB, but ranked below Koth of the Homestead

picks.plan: Open. GW lifegain is the deck he would like, but Kwia is framed as splashable in any white deck from the first pick.
quotes: qua is just like giant 6/6 flyer. If they can't kill it, you win the game
We can also just splash it in any white deck.

picks.reasoning: Long deliberation between Ruric Thar, Magecrusher and Blossom-Blessed Angel; the missing rare gives no strong signal. Does not want to commit to a gold pair right after Kwia. Ends on Teyo: a good two-drop in his main colour.

considered.Ruric Thar, Magecrusher: 'kind of want to try taking' it; rejected as committing to a colour pair
considered.Blossom-Blessed Angel: 'very strong', works with the same cards; nearly the pick
considered.Unflinching Hortimancer: lifegain card, 'just good card in general'

picks.plan: White is the main colour ('in my main color'); green not committed.
quotes: I don't necessarily want to commit to playing that color combo right after I took [Kwia]
Teyo is also very good. I like getting a good two drop and it's in my main color.

picks.reasoning: Likes Campus Crier a lot (surveil, copies stack). Passes the GW land and Archive Arbiter because he does not take seven-drops highly.

considered.Vigorbloom Annex: GW land, 'which I'm not going to take'
considered.Archive Arbiter: 'I just don't love taking seven drops too highly'

picks.plan: White two-drops.
quotes: I like Campus Crier a lot.
I just don't love taking seven drops too highly.

picks.reasoning: Sees blue. Weighs Countersculpt, Loot, the Nexus (ramps into his big cards and splashes) and Warrior's Blades (the pick if splashing). Takes Ruric Thar, Biomagus, a card he is impressed with every time, explicitly to avoid committing to green.

considered.Loot, the Nexus: can ramp to the big stuff and splash
considered.Warrior's Blades: 'if I did want to splash, Warrior's Blades could be the pick'

picks.plan: First move off green: blue becomes the second colour candidate next to white.
quotes: Yeah, I don't want to get too committed to green.
It's like a card that I'm very impressed with every time I play it.

picks.reasoning: Twisted Fates is 'a very good card'; Blossom-Blessed Angel is also good, but he can splash Kwia or splash Twisted Fates.
picks.plan: White base; Kwia (G) and Twisted Fates (B) both described as splashes.
quotes: we can just splash the Qua if we really need to or splash Twisted Fates

picks.reasoning: Takes the land because it helps cast Twisted Fates or Kwia; the blue card would not make his deck yet.
picks.plan: Fixing for the splashes.
quotes: Now, this land helps me with the twisted fates or with the qua.
The blue card isn't going to get in right now

picks.reasoning: Second Campus Crier; copies stack up. Looking back at the Ruric Thar pick: he was already thinking WU splashing Kwia.
picks.plan: WU splashing Kwia, stated outright.
quotes: We'll just take another campus crier.
At the time I was like thinking I could play white blue splash qua. Qua is very splashable.

picks.reasoning: Blessed Ghoul wants enchantments he does not have; maybe he will splash green; takes the land. Notes UB cards flowing. Rates Pia low.

considered.Pia, Aether Ascetic: 'I just don't think Pia is very good'

picks.plan: Splash green, fixing.
quotes: Maybe I'll just want to splash green. Maybe I'll just take the land.

considered.Fateshaper Aspirant: 'I really don't like the Fateshaper even though I have a couple cards'

picks.plan: Fixing again (Murmuring Volume makes any colour).

picks.reasoning: Unsummon over Ferocity of the Hunt and over Infinite Coursework.

considered.Ruric Thar, Biomagus: already has one; 'another second top end card'
considered.Theorix Charm: UB charm, read as a signal

picks.plan: Splash fixing over a second copy of his blue top end.

picks.plan: 'White blue splashing every other color.'

picks.reasoning: No comment. The pick went to the sideboard at once.

picks.reasoning: Last card.

considered.Murmuring Volume: already in the pool; goes with the splash-everything plan

quotes: Jace is a pretty sweet pickup for our white blue deck that is going to splash every other color.
Getting a Jace is really good because that's one of our base color cards.

considered.Vinelasher Adept: 'we could just take a land cycler'; deferred

picks.plan: WU 'splashing around'; green as a splash for a strong green card.
quotes: I think Mowu is really strong.

picks.reasoning: Lots of options: Loot, the Nexus, Warrior's Blades, another card. Takes Loot: if it survives it does a lot of work. Regrets it next pick (green is only a splash).
picks.plan: Still treating green as heavy; corrected one pick later.
quotes: Let's take Loot the Nexus.
If it survives, we're going to be able to do a lot of good work with it

picks.reasoning: Splash cards and a green card on offer; first leans 'take another land here', then realises Loot was a mistake because green is not a base colour and he has double-blue cards. Takes a blue two-drop for the early game.

considered.Formidable Commons: 'take another land here', then changed his mind

picks.plan: Explicit correction: green is a splash, not a base colour; base is WU (double-blue cards).

I should have just taken the tap land. I kind of forgot that green wasn't a base color because I do have these double blue cards
I'm just going to take a two drop of blue. That'll actually be better.

picks.plan: Five-colour lands deck around a WU base.

how many like random lands can you play?
